verdict.rationale: Base44's own docs describe a no-code flow where users describe what they want and the AI builds the app. The output includes a managed backend, built-in data tables and ready-made login pages. Independent users confirm getting fully functional, deployable apps from prompts, with an integrated database. Missing for 10: documented detail on how far a single prompt goes for complex apps, since one user reports the one-prompt framing is overstated for larger builds such as web shops.

support.subject: As a founder, I can describe an app in natural language and get a working full-stack application

citations.quote: You do not need any coding or tech skills. Just describe what you want to build, and Base44 will bring your idea to life.
